brief: Disclosures for Entero Therapeutics (formerly First Wave BioPharma and AzurRx BioPharma). Its stopped phase 2 trials: NCT04858425 (terminated after topline data), NCT04839575 and NCT04243551 (terminated, enrollment), NCT04542434 and NCT04436458 (withdrawn). For each, find what the company told investors in 8-Ks near the stop. Quote the 8-K language exactly and say whether it gives a reason.

findings.claim: For NCT04858425 (RESERVOIR trial), the 8-K filed on 2022-04-29 stated: "While the top-line efficacy measure from the RESERVOIR trial did not show any anti-viral activity, the drug was well-tolerated without". It names the trial and gives an efficacy reason.
findings.notes: Filing excerpt directly quotes the top-line results announcement for NCT04858425.

findings.claim: For NCT04839575, search of SEC 8-K filings found no specific mentions of the trial or trial stopping reasons in the retrieved excerpts near the stop.
findings.notes: Filings discuss latiglutenase Phase 3 planning but do not mention NCT04839575 specifically.

findings.claim: For NCT04243551, search of SEC 8-K filings found no specific mentions of the trial in the retrieved excerpts near the stop.
findings.notes: Filings discuss business combinations and pipeline streamlining but do not mention NCT04243551.

findings.claim: For NCT04542434, search of SEC 8-K filings found no specific mentions of the trial in the retrieved excerpts near the stop.
findings.notes: Filings discuss pipeline programs generally for niclosamide without mentioning NCT04542434.

findings.claim: For NCT04436458, search of SEC 8-K filings found no specific mentions of the trial in the retrieved excerpts near the stop.
findings.notes: Filings discuss pipeline programs generally for niclosamide without mentioning NCT04436458.

gaps: No specific 8-K disclosures mentioning NCT04839575, NCT04243551, NCT04542434, or NCT04436458 were found in the available SEC EDGAR snapshot records.
